content: {"paper_id":"W4403758858","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"Semi-supervised clustering leverages prior information in the form of constraints to achieve higher-quality clustering outcomes.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文标题与摘要以半监督聚类为核心任务，利用约束形式的先验信息结合未标注数据进行聚类，满足半监督学习设定。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"we formulate a uniform view for widely used pairwise and label constraints.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要将pairwise与label约束统一为监督信号并融入聚类，属于用不完整/粗粒度的约束监督替代完整实例标签，且为论文核心设定。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"pairwise-constraint-propagation","reason_zh":"摘要提到pairwise constraints并用于半监督聚类，但未说明对must-link/cannot-link关系进行扩展或传播，无法确认满足‘传播’定义。"}],"input_issues":[]}
